message:
The `decodeMetaData` is called after `decodeRaw`. The crash happens in `decodeRaw` (specifically in `CorrectQuadrantMultipliersCombined` which is called from `decodeRawInternal`). So I don't need to worry about `decodeMetaData`.

Now let me also check `setMetaData` and `checkCameraSupported` to make sure they don't throw before we reach the vulnerable code. Actually, `checkSupport` is commented out in the fuzzer (`// decoder->checkSupport(&metadata);`), so that's not an issue.

Let me also check `setMetaData`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/librawspeed && grep -n "setMetaData" src/librawspeed/decoders/RawDecoder.cpp | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
